pathway.title: TransDigm historical legal-to-funding review
pathway.question: How do the notes provisions change funding and creditor-risk assessment?

cells.text: View: The newly evidenced notes covenants narrow the earlier blanket legal-data gap and identify conditional refinancing routes, but do not establish executable funding or unused capacity. TDG's positive operating cash and historical financing execution support a feasible funding countercase; allocation-led cash depletion and the fully drawn receivables facility make dated access verification decisive. This focused CP-3C intake is Completed with Limitations, not a replacement full CP-3C run, current underwriting or whole-pathway conclusion.

The primary selections substantiate CP-4's funding-relevant conclusions: incurrence FCCR is strictly >2.0, while debt and lien permission require separate tests. There is no notes maintenance-ratio intervention identified by CP-4. Legal FCCR cannot use 4173/1158: restricted-group legal earnings, four-quarter availability, fixed charges including noncash/capitalized interest and preferred dividends, and transaction pro formas differ from reported annual cash coverage. [S pp.1–3, L403–431, L1295.] Thus financial deterioration can precede a legal default; conversely, legal qualification does not supply cash.

Independent Permitted Indebtedness routes and reclassification can facilitate ordinary refinancing. Their conditions, existing usage and restricted/guarantor perimeter matter: the facilities limb is not an untouched USD3100m allowance, and non-guarantor ratio debt has a USD400m outstanding limit. 5.25x is the secured-net condition for liens securing Ratio Indebtedness, not a universal cap on all debt. Debt permission AND lien permission, plus applicable guarantee and perimeter conditions, must be satisfied. Actual unused capacity remains unknown. [S pp.2–3, L603, L615, L624, L628–640, L715, L1295, L1338; CP-4 P03–P07.]

September cash 6261 cannot substitute for December 2459. Issuer December liquidity 3308 includes 849 reported revolver availability; neither that availability nor the full cash balance is independently certified deployable. Positive Q1 CFO 752 and historical refinancing execution are substantial counterevidence to an operating-collapse thesis. Nevertheless, Q1 distributions 4396 and repurchases 316 demonstrate that operating generation need not be retained. CP-2's forecast coverage warnings and CP-2A's 7x/3x watches are economic sensitivities, not indenture triggers. [CP-2D T2E.2–8; CP-2 Findings; CP-2A T2B.4–8.]

The RP ratio alternative requires no default and pro forma FCCR >2.0, with specific contracted-payment provisions. It does not prove the historical distribution used that route or was permitted through any selected route. Even a demonstrated prior permitted distribution would not certify future access. Financial pressure and flexible permissions establish neither unrestricted LME permission nor intent. [S p.3, L1265–1277.]

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: These are consumed facts and CP-4's conditional illustration, **not new tool calculations**. A/R and cash rows are from CP-2D T2E.2–3/Calculations; original notes and illustration from CP-4 Calculations. The final three em dashes mean, respectively: **Not calculable** without legal financial/usage schedules; **Not supplied** as certified future access; **Not calculable** without payment date, eligible principal and accrual history. Missing is not zero.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: The prescribed CoC principal-component control **1515** represents 101% of assumed tender of all original **1500**, including the **15** premium; the premium must not be added again. Accrued interest is additional and missing. Original issue principal is not current eligible principal, a current maturity or a payable obligation; trigger and tenders are unknown. Optional redemption has separate call/make-whole terms. [CP-4 P14/Calculations; S pp.3–4, L1345–1368.]

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: A/R **650 commitment** differs from September **487 gross/486 carrying** and December **650/649 fully drawn**. October **162.5** and quarterly **163** describe the same draw at different precision, not two funding sources. LC **61** is not new funded debt. No cash-minus-all-carrying-debt calculation is made. September broader claims **25002** is neither legal debt nor immediate cash need. Annual FY2025 principal **93** and lease **22/20** windows cannot be treated as December remaining needs; December remaining-FY lease **21/19** requires finance principal/interest separation and no second OCF deduction. [CP-2D Calculations/T2E.3; CP-2A E4–E6.]

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: The broad legal gap is narrowed for these named notes, not eliminated across the capital structure. Separate A/R/credit agreements, later amendments, legal financial and basket-usage certificates, cash accessibility, actual ICA/security bodies, perfection and the obligor/value map remain missing. Complete weekly/monthly sources/uses, minimum operating cash and dated interest/principal schedules are also absent. Consequently no certified funding gap, runway, unused debt capacity, default, recovery estimate or completed transaction is established.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: The strongest positive case would prevail with demonstrated recurring cash conversion, restrained uncommitted allocation, verified cash/revolver access and a documented funded renewal or repayment plan. Missing evidence does not itself prove distress. Confidence is Medium for this bounded funding interpretation; legal clause evidence is stronger than transaction-execution evidence.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Request targeted evidence, not a rerun merely for delivery: treasury/lenders supply the dated historical July extension or repayment record, borrowing-base and recourse terms, accessible-cash/minimum-cash schedule and funded payment forecast. Counsel supplies transaction-specific debt/lien/RP routes and usage, actual ICA/security bodies, release chain and eligible consent population. For any proposed notes exit, obtain trigger facts, remaining eligible principal, tenders, call/payment date, accrued interest and other-debt consents.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: CP-2D/CP-2G can incorporate verified access and payment timing; CP-4 can resolve route/control questions; CP-5 should validate these exact current hashes, primary locators and control transcription. Later outcomes require a separately dated update. No downstream execution, report delivery acceptance or whole-pathway completion is claimed.
